title: Week's best: Dyson Clean+Wash £239, Ninja Dual Zone £119.99 and Kindle £119.99
description: Black Friday week's best UK deals still live: Dyson Clean+Wash £239, Ninja Dual Zone £119.99, Kindle £119.99, AirPods Pro 3 £155.98 and more.
intro:
**It's Black Friday, and the best deal of the week is now the Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene wet floor cleaner at £239 on Amazon, £20 lower than on Monday and £190 under its usual price.** The Ninja Foodi Dual Zone air fryer is still £119.99, the new Kindle is holding at its record low of £119.99 and the AirPods Pro 3 are £155.98. For the kitchen, the Ninja Crispi is £99 and the Sage Bambino Plus is down to £349.

This roundup only includes deals we could re-check on sources dated 26 or 27 November (TechRadar's UK and Amazon UK live blogs, and T3), so treat it as a shortlist of what's still live, not a promise. Buy now or wait? Now, for anything here. Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to Cyber Monday (30 November), but these prices have held all week and are unlikely to drop further, while popular colours and bundles keep selling out.

deals.name: Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene wet floor cleaner
deals.note: Dyson's mop for hard floors, now £20 cheaper than it was on Monday. Worth it if you have a lot of tiles or laminate; carpets still need a vacuum. More in our [Black Friday vacuum deals](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight.

deals.name: Dyson V8 cordless vacuum
deals.note: The cheapest way into a Dyson stick vac, and it has held this price all week. Fine for a flat or for quick top-ups; bigger homes should look at the V15 in our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone 7.6L air fryer (AF300UK)
deals.note: Two baskets that finish at the same time, so a whole family meal cooks at once. Still £80 off, and one TechRadar entry has it a penny cheaper at £119. Compare models in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Crispi 3.8L glass air fryer
deals.note: A glass air fryer whose basket doubles as a storage dish, good for one or two people. Under £100 for the first time this week, and still there on Black Friday eve.

deals.name: Sage The Bambino Plus espresso machine
deals.note: A compact machine with automatic milk texturing, so flat whites are easy even for beginners. Pair it with a grinder, or see our [coffee machine Black Friday guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/) for bean-to-cup options.

deals.name: Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 electric toothbrush
deals.note: Philips' premium brush with a charging glass and travel case for about a third of its list price. Oral-B fans should see our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Lego Festive Gingerbread House
deals.note: Back to £28, the same price as last week's roundup. A cheerful build for a December evening and a nice table decoration after. More ideas in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (2026, 16GB)
deals.note: The newest basic Kindle at its record low, and an easy gift for a reader. Add a [Kindle Unlimited trial](/guides/kindle-unlimited-free-trial-uk/), or see whether the Paperwhite is worth the extra in [Kindle vs Kindle Paperwhite](/guides/kindle-vs-kindle-paperwhite/).

deals.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
deals.note: Apple's best earbuds at a new low, about £9 under Monday's price. All the details are in our [AirPods Black Friday guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/). Long commute? Audible is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December.

deals.name: Amazon Echo Show 8
deals.note: Half price for a smart display that does video calls, recipes, a photo frame and Ring doorbell views. Fill it with music using an [Amazon Music Unlimited](https://www.amazon.co.uk/music/unlimited) free trial.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Not for these. Every price above has either held or got cheaper over the week, and Amazon's Black Friday Week ends on Cyber Monday, 30 November, rather than bringing a second round of cuts. If you missed something, see [when is Cyber Monday 2026 UK](/guides/when-is-cyber-monday-2026-uk/) for what to expect on the 30th, and our [Black Friday live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/), which we update through the day.

We've left out deals we couldn't re-check today, including the Ring doorbell and indoor camera bundle (TechRadar says the £39.99 version sold out and a near-identical bundle replaced it at £44.99).

## This week's spotlight

Our [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight covers the cordless, robot and wet floor cleaners worth buying and what to pay. For more, see [Shark vs Dyson cordless](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/) and our [robot vacuum deals guide](/guides/robot-vacuum-deals-uk/).

Not a Prime member? Some Amazon deal prices need Prime, and a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the rest of Black Friday Week. For everything else, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
